display_long_description:
A Zanichelli 3D physics lab in virtual reality for Meta Quest that transforms the study of physics into an immersive and interactive experience.
Users can access a series of virtual labs designed to explore the main topics of experimental physics, from fundamental quantities to mechanics, from electricity to thermodynamics.

Within the VR environments, users can utilize virtual tools, take measurements, observe physical phenomena, and verify laws and mathematical relationships through hands-on experimentation. The labs include activities on mass, density, forces, motion, oscillations, inclined planes, electrical circuits, Ohm’s law, volt-ampere characteristics, and heat transfer.

The immersive approach enhances understanding of theoretical concepts, stimulates active learning, and allows for experimentation in complete safety, without limitations on materials or physical space. The app is designed as an educational tool for students, teachers, and educational settings, offering an innovative and engaging way to learn physics through experience.
